architectural_notes: Leaderboard timeframe filters should compare integer day numbers (e.g., selected day index) rather than nanosecond timestamps to ensure correct 7/30-day windows.
known_issues: Leaderboard weekly/monthly filters are not filtering correctly and may return all-time results due to timestamp comparison logic.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix leaderboard weekly/monthly timeframe filtering (currently shows all-time results) by comparing integer day numbers instead of timestamps

Update backend leaderboard timeframe filtering so the Weekly and Monthly filters return only results inside the intended day windows by comparing integer day IDs (the same day IDs used when recording results) instead of comparing nanosecond timestamps.

Ensure recording and removing results (recordDailyWin/recordDailyLoss/decrementDailyLog) continue to work without requiring any data migration, and the corrected timeframe filtering works immediately for existing stored daily logs.

projectName: Fix leaderboard weekly/monthly timeframe filtering to use integer day comparisons
